description.value:
You quickly create a barrier that protects you against the magic of spellcraft. You gain resistance 5 against damage from spells.

The resistance from this spell is cumulative with that of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Arcane Cascade]. If you're in Arcane Cascade stance when the duration of conjurer's countermeasure expires, the spell's duration extends until Arcane Cascade ends.

Heightened (+3) The resistance increases by 5.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Spell Effect: Cascade Countermeasure]

duration.value: until the Arcane Cascade stance ends
